[[Star Wars Day-at-a-Time Calendar 20{{{1}}}|''Star Wars'' Day-at-a-Time Calendar 20{{{1}}}]], "{{{2|{{PAGENAME}}}}}" {{C|{{{3}}}}}<noinclude>

==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace "YEAR", "ENTRY", and "DAY" with the appropriate information.
<pre><nowiki>{{</nowiki>CalendarCite|''YEAR''|''ENTRY''|''DAY''}}</pre>

For ease of citation, you may copy the code listed in the (currently incomplete) [[Template:CalendarCite/2020]] repository.

*Only the last two digits of the year need to be provided. (e.g. "'''19'''," not "'''2019'''")
*Entry is the name as it appears in the title of the calendar entry.
*The month is provided before the day. (e.g. "'''September 1'''" and "'''March 3'''")
**If a single entry covers two days, provide both days separated by a forward slash. (e.g. "'''August 29/30'''")
***If the two days are of different months, provide the days with their respective months, and separate the dates by a forward slash. (e.g. "'''February 29/March 1'''")

===Examples===
*{{CalendarCite|20|Jedi Mind Trick|August 29/20}}
<pre><nowiki>{{CalendarCite|20|Jedi Mind Trick|August 29/20}}</nowiki></pre>

*{{CalendarCite|20|Twi'lek|October 28}}
<pre><nowiki>{{CalendarCite|20|Twi'lek|October 28}}</nowiki></pre>
